description:
About Brainbase

Brainbase is building the primitives for the next 1B agents.

We power internal agents across government, Fortune 500, frontier labs and hyper-growth startups. Enterprises use our configurable primitives such as evals, observability, router, authentication, permissions, sandboxes, harnesses and more to deploy internal agents securely at scale. We support 8+ harness and 50+ models, including sovereign deployments.



About Brainbase Embed

Brainbase Embed is a multi-month outcome-oriented deployment program where we engage with high-value customers by embedding engineers internally to manage their Brainbase deployment from start to finish.



Launches

Take a look at some of our previous launches to get an idea of what we’re working on:

 - Brainbase platform: https://brainbaselabs.com/blog/brainbase-is-now-ga

 - Universal Managed Agents API: https://brainbaselabs.com/blog/universal-managed-agents

 - Universal Agent Protocol (UAP) (open-source): universalagentprotocol.io http://universalagentprotocol.io



About the role

You would be primarily responsible for 1-or-more accounts at a time and see their process from post-sales to deployment and beyond.
